ITEM.PTXT: The HDD navigation system displays the image from the rear view monitor camera mounted at the rear of the vehicle together with the signals for each guide line, calculated and predicted based on vehicle condition information input from the steering sensor, etc., and provides voice guidance through the front speaker RH and tweeter RH.
The HDD navigation system receives signals from each switch and sensor and displays the back guide monitor screen under the control of the built-in back guide monitor computer.
